caption:
Sainsbury's is back at it again with the BFG for another festive holiday ad. At this point, Roald Dahl's giant has a more stable seasonal acting career than half of Hollywood. Why do supermarkets love spending so much money on cute storytelling ads in December? Drop your thoughts below.

Source: Campaign UK

#Sainsburys #ChristmasAds #BrandStrategy #HolidayCampaign #Marketing

post.news: Sainsbury's brought back the BFG for its third Christmas ad campaign featuring the Roald Dahl character.
post.take: Brands really looked at a giant who eats snozzcumbers and said yes that will sell groceries.
post.insight: Using familiar fictional characters year after year helps brands build instant emotional connection during the noisy holiday season.
